# HereFishyFishy

> Free Ontario river fishing conditions app at herefishyfishy.ca. For a river section, fish and date it combines live river flow, weather, water temperature and the 2026 Ontario fishing regulations, then says whether to go, where to stand and what to bring. Built by TJ, a GTA angler. No account or download needed.

The app covers rivers in Ontario fishing zones 16 and 17, including the Credit, Humber, Black Creek, Don, Rouge, Duffins, Bronte, Sixteen Mile, Ganaraska, Bowmanville, Wilmot, Grand, Speed, Eramosa, Saugeen, Nottawasaga and Beaver. Fish: steelhead, Chinook salmon, coho salmon (Bowmanville and the Ganaraska), brown trout, rainbow trout and brook trout.

How it works:

- Live flow from Water Survey of Canada gauges, with an estimated flow 1 to 7 days out for most gauges.
- Weather and cloud cover from Open-Meteo, with a best fishing window from the trip date's sunrise and sunset.
- Water temperature: live Credit Valley Conservation readings on the Credit, a weather-based model elsewhere.
- Regulations checked reach by reach against the 2026 Ontario Fishing Regulations Summary. The app never recommends water that is closed on the trip date.
- A free weekly email (Thursday) with the best days from Friday to the following Wednesday on the rivers a subscriber picks, and a monthly outlook.

## App

- [Conditions app](https://herefishyfishy.ca/): pick a date, a city or a river, and a fish; the app picks the reach, the access spot, the method and the gear
- [This month's outlook](https://herefishyfishy.ca/outlook/): best steelhead dates by region (West, Central and East GTA) as a calendar, updated at the start of each month
- [Live Credit River steelhead conditions](https://herefishyfishy.ca/credit-river/steelhead): server-rendered conditions page; also [Chinook salmon](https://herefishyfishy.ca/credit-river/chinook-salmon), [brown trout](https://herefishyfishy.ca/credit-river/brown-trout), [rainbow trout](https://herefishyfishy.ca/credit-river/rainbow-trout) and [brook trout](https://herefishyfishy.ca/credit-river/brook-trout)

## Rivers

- [All rivers](https://herefishyfishy.ca/rivers/): every covered river with its fish and seasons
- [Credit River](https://herefishyfishy.ca/rivers/credit/): overview by section
- [Humber River](https://herefishyfishy.ca/rivers/humber/): salmon and steelhead, Old Mill in fall, winter and spring, rules below and above Eglinton
- [Don River](https://herefishyfishy.ca/rivers/don/): the Chinook run in Toronto, Pottery Road to Sunnybrook, open all year below Eglinton
- [Duffins Creek](https://herefishyfishy.ca/rivers/duffins/): Ajax and Pickering; open all year to the CN line, to December 31 up to Highway 2, to September 30 above it
- [Bronte Creek](https://herefishyfishy.ca/rivers/bronte/): the latest salmon run of the season
- [Ganaraska River salmon run](https://herefishyfishy.ca/rivers/ganaraska/salmon-run/): Port Hope run dates and the September 1 to October 14 closure
- [Bowmanville Creek salmon run](https://herefishyfishy.ca/rivers/bowmanville/salmon-run/): run timing and where to fish

## Guides

- [All guides](https://herefishyfishy.ca/guides/)
- [Steelhead run timing](https://herefishyfishy.ca/guides/steelhead-run-timing/): when steelhead run in Ontario, river by river, and which reaches stay open all year
- [Salmon run timing](https://herefishyfishy.ca/guides/salmon-run-timing/): when Chinook run in Ontario rivers, river by river
- [Trout after September 30](https://herefishyfishy.ca/guides/trout-after-september-30/): brook trout close September 30 everywhere in zones 16 and 17; which lower reaches stay open for brown and rainbow trout
- [Winter steelhead](https://herefishyfishy.ca/guides/winter-steelhead/): open water after September 30, where fish sit in cold water, float setup and baits
- [Where steelhead hold](https://herefishyfishy.ca/guides/where-steelhead-hold/): reading pools, runs and seams so you stop fishing dead water
- [Salmon float fishing tips](https://herefishyfishy.ca/guides/salmon-float-fishing-tips/): where to start the drift, leader length under the float, holding the float back
- [Euro nymphing the Upper Credit](https://herefishyfishy.ca/guides/euro-nymphing-upper-credit/): rainbows at the Forks of the Credit, fly changes, season and barbless rules

## About

- [About HereFishyFishy](https://herefishyfishy.ca/about/): who builds it, how the readings and ratings work
